Description: Wall and Wall is a local and professional mural company with work found all over California and the US. Based in the Bay Area, we are passionate about transforming spaces to inspire community engagement. Our art comes in many forms, including large scale wall murals, interactive murals (light and sound), 3D art installations, and live events. We consider ourselves visual storytellers, so our inspiration comes from the context of the project or client. This location is mainly used for design. Painting it's always performed at the client's premises.
